name: Vászoly (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, light grey and green in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vászoly (a green and white shield with a chevron, a cross, flowers and a ploughshare) below the name VÁSZOLY in grey.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
